IDS_ENABLE_DEBUGGING_HELP.en:
BEGIN_H3Debugging FeaturesEND_H3
          BR
          You can enable the debugging features on your NickelOS device in order to install and test custom code on your device.  This will allow you to:BR
          BEGIN_LIST
            LIST_ITEMRemove rootfs verification so you can modify OS files
            LIST_ITEMEnable SSH access to the device using the standard test keys so you can use tools such as BEGIN_CODE'cros flash'END_CODE to access the device
            LIST_ITEMEnable booting from USB so you can install an OS image from a USB drive
            LIST_ITEMSet both the dev and the system root login password to a custom value so you can manually SSH into the device
          END_LIST
          BR
          Once enabled, most of the debugging features will remain enabled even after performing a powerwash or wiping the data on an enterprise managed device.  To fully disable all debugging features, reinstall NickelOS.
          BR
          BR
          For more information about the debugging features see:BR
          https://www.chromium.org/chromium-os/how-tos-and-troubleshooting/debugging-features
          BR
          BR
          BEGIN_BOLDNote:END_BOLD  The system will reboot during the process.
IDS_ENABLE_DEBUGGING_HELP.t:
BEGIN_H3Vipengele vya UtatuziEND_H3
          BR
          Unaweza kuwasha vipengele vya utatuzi kwenye kifaa chako cha NickelOS ili uweke na ujaribu misimbo maalum kwenye kifaa chako.  Hatua hii itakuruhusu:BR
          BEGIN_LIST
            LIST_ITEMUondoe uthibitishaji wa msingi ili uweze kurekebisha faili za Mfumo wa Uendeshaji
            LIST_ITEMUwashe ufikiaji wa SSH kwenye kifaa ukitumia funguo za kawaida za jaribio ili uweze kufikia kifaa ukitumia zana kama vile BEGIN_CODE'cros flash'END_CODE
            LIST_ITEMUruhusu kuwasha kupitia USB ili uweze kuweka nakala ya Mfumo wa Uendeshaji kutoka kwenye hifadhi ya USB
            LIST_ITEMUweke mipangilio ya nenosiri la kuingia katika akaunti ya msingi ya mfumo na ya usanidi, iwe thamani maalum ili uweze kuweka mwenyewe SSH kwenye kifaa
          END_LIST
          BR
          Baada ya kuwashwa, vipengele vingi vya utatuzi vitasalia katika hali ya kuwashwa hata baada ya kuondoa data iliyo kwenye kifaa isipatikane kabisa au kurejesha mipangilio kilichotoka nayo kiwandani kwenye kifaa kinachodhibitiwa na kampuni. Ili uzime kabisa vipengele vyote vya utatuzi, sakinisha upya NickelOS.
          BR
          BR
          Ili upate maelezo zaidi kuhusu vipengele vya utatuzi angalia:BR
          https://www.chromium.org/chromium-os/how-tos-and-troubleshooting/debugging-features
          BR
          BR
          BEGIN_BOLDKumbuka:END_BOLD  Mfumo utazima kisha kuwashwa tena wakati wa mchakato huu.

IDS_NICKEL_CAMERA_OFF_MESSAGE.en: APP_NAME wants to use the camera. To let it, turn on camera access in Privacy controls.
IDS_NICKEL_CAMERA_OFF_MESSAGE.t: APP_NAME inataka kutumia kamera. Ili uiruhusu, washa ufikiaji wa kamera katika Vidhibiti vya faragha.

IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_HINT.en: To change a shortcut, select its keys and press new ones. Backspace removes it.
IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_HINT.t: Ili ubadilishe njia ya mkato, chagua vitufe vyake kisha ubonyeze vipya. Backspace huiondoa.

IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_MESSAGE.en: APP_NAME wants these shortcuts to work while you use other apps too. It learns only when you press them, not what else you type.
IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_MESSAGE.t: APP_NAME inataka njia hizi za mkato zifanye kazi hata unapotumia programu nyingine. Inafahamu tu unapozibonyeza, haifahamu kitu kingine chochote unachoandika.

IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_NEEDS_MODIFI.en: Use Ctrl, Alt or Search with the key, or a function key.
IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_NEEDS_MODIFI.t: Tumia Ctrl, Alt au Tafuta pamoja na kitufe, au tumia kitufe cha kukokotoa.

IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_TAKEN.en: Those keys are already in use. Try others.
IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_TAKEN.t: Vitufe hivyo tayari vinatumika. Jaribu vingine.

IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_TITLE.t: Ungependa kuruhusu njia za mkato za kibodi?

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_FAILED_DE.en: Could not create the account: DETAIL.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_SIGN_IN.en: Could not set up the account: DETAIL
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_SIGN_IN.t: Imeshindwa kuweka mipangilio ya akaunti: DETAIL

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_TAKEN.t: Jina hilo la mtumiaji tayari linatumika.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_TOO_LONG.en: Creating the account took too long. Try again.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_TOO_LONG.t: Kufungua akaunti kumechukua muda mrefu mno. Jaribu tena.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_USERNAME.en: Usernames start with a lowercase letter and use only lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (up to 32).
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_USERNAME.t: Majina ya watumiaji huanza na herufi ndogo na hutumia herufi ndogo, tarakimu, - na _ pekee (hadi 32).

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_PICTURE_SUBTITL.en: It shows on the sign-in screen and in the system tray. To use a photo of your own, go to Settings later.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_PICTURE_SUBTITL.t: Huonekana kwenye skrini ya kuingia katika akaunti na kwenye trei ya mfumo. Ili utumie picha yako mwenyewe, nenda kwenye Mipangilio baadaye.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_SUBTITLE.en: Your account and its files live on this device, encrypted with your password. Without a Google account there is no way to recover them if you forget it.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_SUBTITLE.t: Akaunti yako na faili zake zimehifadhiwa kwenye kifaa hiki, zikiwa zimesimbwa kwa njia fiche kwa nenosiri lako. Bila akaunti ya Google, hakuna njia ya kuzirejesha ukilisahau nenosiri.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_USERNAME_ERROR.en: Start with a lowercase letter; use lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (up to 32)
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_USERNAME_ERROR.t: Anza na herufi ndogo; tumia herufi ndogo, tarakimu, - na _ (hadi 32)

IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_ACCESS_MESSAGE.en: APP_NAME wants to know where this device is, found from nearby Wi-Fi networks and its internet address. Your answer is remembered for this app.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_ACCESS_MESSAGE.t: APP_NAME inataka kujua mahali kifaa hiki kilipo, kunakotambuliwa kupitia mitandao ya Wi-Fi iliyo karibu na anwani yake ya intaneti. Jibu lako litakumbukwa kwa ajili ya programu hii.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_ACCESS_TITLE.en: Allow APP_NAME to use your location?
IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_ACCESS_TITLE.t: Ungependa kuruhusu APP_NAME itumie data ya mahali ulipo?

IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_OFF_MESSAGE.en: APP_NAME wants to use your location. To let it, turn on location access in Privacy controls.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_OFF_MESSAGE.t: APP_NAME inataka kutumia data ya mahali ulipo. Ili uiruhusu, washa ufikiaji wa data ya mahali katika Vidhibiti vya faragha.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_OFF_TITLE.t: Ufikiaji wa data ya mahali umezimwa

IDS_NICKEL_REMOTE_CONTROL_MESSAGE.en: APP_NAME wants to control this device's keyboard and pointer. Allow it only if you trust whoever is connecting.
IDS_NICKEL_REMOTE_CONTROL_MESSAGE.t: APP_NAME inataka kudhibiti kibodi na kiashiria cha kifaa hiki. Ruhusu tu ikiwa unamwamini mtu anayeunganisha.

IDS_NICKEL_SEARCH_ENGINE_CHOICE_INFO_DIA.en: You chose Minimal when you set up NickelOS, so no search engine was picked for you. These search engines are popular in your region and are shown in random order.
IDS_NICKEL_SEARCH_ENGINE_CHOICE_INFO_DIA.t: Ulichagua “Msingi” ulipoweka mipangilio ya NickelOS, kwa hivyo hukuchaguliwa mtambo wowote wa kutafuta. Mitambo hii ya kutafuta ni maarufu katika eneo lako na inaonyeshwa kwa mpangilio nasibu.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_EITHER_WAY.en: Either way, you get Bazaar to find more apps, and apps to open your photos, videos, music and documents.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_EITHER_WAY.t: Kwa vyovyote vile, utapata Bazaar ili upate programu zaidi, pamoja na programu za kufungua picha, video, muziki na hati zako.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_FULL_DESCRIPTION.en: Everything ready to go, and private. DuckDuckGo searches the web from the browser and the launcher, uBlock Origin blocks ads and trackers in the browser, Proton's private apps (Mail, Calendar, Drive, Pass and more) are installed, and free, open-source apps come with it: LibreOffice, OBS Studio, GIMP, Kdenlive and more.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_FULL_DESCRIPTION.t: Kila kitu kiko tayari, na ni cha faragha. DuckDuckGo hutafuta kwenye wavuti kupitia kivinjari na kizindua, uBlock Origin huzuia matangazo na vifuatiliaji kwenye kivinjari, programu za faragha za Proton (Mail, Calendar, Drive, Pass na nyinginezo) husakinishwa, na programu huria zisizolipishwa huja pamoja nayo: LibreOffice, OBS Studio, GIMP, Kdenlive na nyinginezo.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_MINIMAL_DESCRIPTION.en: Just the basics. The launcher searches only this computer, and nothing else is set up for you.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_MINIMAL_DESCRIPTION.t: Mambo ya msingi tu. Kizindua hutafuta kwenye kompyuta hii pekee, na hakuna kitu kingine kinachowekwa kwa ajili yako.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_SUBTITLE.en: You can change all of this later in Settings.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_SUBTITLE.t: Unaweza kubadilisha haya yote baadaye katika Mipangilio.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_TITLE.en: How would you like to start?

IDS_OMNIBOX_PEDAL_MANAGE_CHROMEOS_ACCESS.en: Personalize your accessibility tools in NickelOS settings
IDS_OMNIBOX_PEDAL_MANAGE_CHROMEOS_ACCESS.t: Weka mapendeleo ya zana zako za ufikivu katika mipangilio ya NickelOS

IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_ANNOUNCEMENT_TEX.en: Do you want to activate ChromeVox, the built-in screen reader for NickelOS? If so, press the space bar.
IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_ANNOUNCEMENT_TEX.t: Ungependa kuwasha ChromeVox, kisoma skrini kilichojumuishwa cha NickelOS? Ikiwa ndivyo, bonyeza kitufe cha nafasi.

IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_ANNOUNCEMENT_TEX.en: Do you want to activate ChromeVox, the built-in screen reader for NickelOS? If so, press and hold both volume keys for five seconds.
IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_ANNOUNCEMENT_TEX.t: Ungependa kuwasha ChromeVox, kisoma skrini kilichojumuishwa cha NickelOS? Ikiwa ndivyo, bonyeza na ushikilie vitufe vya sauti vyote viwili kwa sekunde tano.

IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_TEXT.en: Do you want to activate ChromeVox, the built-in screen reader for NickelOS?
IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_TEXT.t: Ungependa kuwasha ChromeVox, kisoma skrini kilichojumuishwa cha NickelOS?

IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_CONTENT_0.en: Before starting, make sure you have a backup of your data. Installing DEVICE_OS will overwrite the disk you choose.
IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_CONTENT_0.t: Kabla hujaanza, hakikisha kwamba una nakala ya data yako. Hatua ya kusakinisha DEVICE_OS itafuta data yote iliyo kwenye diski utakayochagua.

IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_FOOTER.en: DEVICE_OS is free software provided as is: it may not work on every computer, and its authors are not responsible for any data loss.
IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_FOOTER.t: DEVICE_OS ni programu huria inayotolewa jinsi ilivyo: huenda isifanye kazi kwenye kila kompyuta, na waundaji wake hawawajibiki kwa upotevu wowote wa data.

IDS_OS_SETTINGS_SYNC_FEATURE_LABEL.en: Your apps and settings will sync across all NickelOS devices where you are signed in with your Google account. For browser sync options, go to LINK_BEGINChrome settingsLINK_END.
IDS_OS_SETTINGS_SYNC_FEATURE_LABEL.t: Mipangilio na programu zako zitasawazishwa kwenye vifaa vyote vinavyotumia NickelOS, ambavyo umeingia kwa kutumia akaunti yako ya Google. Ili upate chaguo za kusawazisha kwenye kivinjari, nenda katika LINK_BEGINMipangilio ya ChromeLINK_END.

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: When your screen is idle, show your pictures, time, and media info
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Onyesha picha zako, saa na maelezo ya maudhui wakati skrini haitumiki

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: The screen saver shows the pictures in your Pictures folder and the folders in it. Add at least 2.
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Taswira ya skrini huonyesha picha zilizo kwenye folda yako ya Pictures na folda zilizo ndani yake. Ongeza angalau picha 2.

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: The screen saver shows NickelOS's wallpapers. Turn this on to show the pictures in My files > Pictures instead.
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Taswira ya skrini huonyesha mandhari ya NickelOS. Washa chaguo hili ili uonyeshe picha zilizo katika Faili zangu > Pictures badala yake.

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: From Open-Meteo, for your approximate location, which beaconDB works out from your internet address
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Kutoka Open-Meteo, kwa makadirio ya mahali ulipo, ambayo beaconDB hubaini kutokana na anwani yako ya IP

IDS_PRINT_PREVIEW_PRINTER_SETUP_INFO_MES.en: Make sure your printer is turned on and connected to the same network as your NickelOS device or use a USB cable
IDS_PRINT_PREVIEW_PRINTER_SETUP_INFO_MES.t: Hakikisha kuwa printa yako imewashwa na imeunganishwa kwenye mtandao sawa na kifaa chako cha NickelOS au utumie kebo ya USB

IDS_SETTINGS_ACCOUNT_BODY_CHROMEOS.en: When on, data is saved in your Google Account and can be used on all your devices. When off, data is saved only to this device. For NickelOS sync options, go to LINK_BEGINNickelOS settingsLINK_END.
IDS_SETTINGS_ACCOUNT_BODY_CHROMEOS.t: Ukiiwasha, data huhifadhiwa kwenye Akaunti yako ya Google na inaweza kutumiwa kwenye vifaa vyako vyote. Ukiizima, data huhifadhiwa kwenye kifaa hiki pekee. Kwa chaguo za usawazishaji wa NickelOS, nenda kwenye LINK_BEGINmipangilio ya NickelOSLINK_END.

IDS_SETTINGS_APPS_ARC_VM_SHARED_USB_DEVI.en: Give Android apps control over USB devices on this NickelOS device. Permission will be requested each time you plug in a USB device. Individual Android apps will ask for additional permissions.
IDS_SETTINGS_APPS_ARC_VM_SHARED_USB_DEVI.t: Zipe Programu za Android udhibiti wa vifaa vya USB kwenye kifaa hiki cha NickelOS. Utaombwa ruhusa kila wakati unapochomeka kifaa cha USB. Programu mahususi za Android zitaomba ruhusa za ziada.

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.en: Your device is no longer receiving security and software updates.
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.t: Kifaa chako hakipokei tena masasisho ya usalama na programu.

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.en: This device no longer gets updates

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.en: Your device is no longer receiving security and software updates.
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.t: Kifaa chako hakipokei tena masasisho ya usalama na programu.

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.en: This device no longer gets updates

IDS_SETTINGS_GUEST_OS_SHARED_USB_DEVICES.en: Give Android apps control over USB devices on this NickelOS device
IDS_SETTINGS_GUEST_OS_SHARED_USB_DEVICES.t: Zipe Programu za Android udhibiti wa vifaa vya USB kwenye kifaa hiki cha NickelOS

IDS_SETTINGS_LANGUAGES_OPEN_CHROME_OS_SE.t: Dhibiti lugha katika mipangilio ya NickelOS

IDS_SETTINGS_NEARBY_SHARE_DATA_USAGE_MOB.en: This option applies to NickelOS devices with a data plan or mobile network dongle, or when tethering to a portable hotspot
IDS_SETTINGS_NEARBY_SHARE_DATA_USAGE_MOB.t: Chaguo hili linatumika kwenye vifaa vya NickelOS vyenye mpango wa data au kifaa cha mtandao wa simu au wakati wa kutumia mtandao pepe uliosambazwa

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADD_PERSON_.en: You'll be signed out. On the sign-in screen, the new person chooses a name, a username and a password.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADD_PERSON_.t: Utaondolewa kwenye akaunti. Kwenye skrini ya kuingia katika akaunti, mtu mpya atachagua jina, jina la mtumiaji na nenosiri.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADMIN_BODY.en: Administrators can install software for everyone, change the system and manage accounts.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADMIN_BODY.t: Wasimamizi wanaweza kusakinisha programu kwa ajili ya kila mtu, kubadilisha mfumo na kudhibiti akaunti.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_LAST_ADMIN.en: This device needs at least one administrator
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_LAST_ADMIN.t: Kifaa hiki kinahitaji angalau msimamizi mmoja

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_NO_OTHER_PE.en: No one else has an account on this device.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_NO_OTHER_PE.t: Hakuna mtu mwingine aliye na akaunti kwenye kifaa hiki.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_OTHER_PEOPL.en: Everyone has their own account and files. Administrators can install software for everyone, change the system and manage accounts.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_OTHER_PEOPL.t: Kila mtu ana akaunti na faili zake. Wasimamizi wanaweza kusakinisha programu kwa ajili ya kila mtu, kubadilisha mfumo na kudhibiti akaunti.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_REMOVE_ADMI.t: Ungependa kumfanya NAME kuwa mtumiaji wa kawaida?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_REMOVE_BODY.en: Their account and all their files are deleted from this device. This can't be undone.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_REMOVE_BODY.t: Akaunti yake na faili zake zote zitafutwa kwenye kifaa hiki. Hatua hii haiwezi kutenduliwa.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ADMIN_ONLY.en: Only an administrator of this device can change these.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ADMIN_ONLY.t: Msimamizi wa kifaa hiki pekee ndiye anayeweza kubadilisha mipangilio hii.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DESCRIPT.en: For apps built only for the ARM processors phones use, many games among them. Proprietary software, downloaded when you turn it on.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DESCRIPT.t: Kwa programu zilizoundwa kwa ajili ya vichakataji vya ARM vinavyotumiwa na simu pekee, zikiwemo michezo mingi. Ni programu isiyo huria, inayopakuliwa unapowasha kipengele hiki.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.en: Many Android apps, games especially, are built only for the ARM processors phones use. To run them on this computer, Android needs a translator. NickelOS doesn't make or include one: turning this on downloads TRANSLATOR from GitHub, the same copy the Waydroid community's waydroid_script installs.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.t: Programu nyingi za Android, hasa michezo, zimeundwa kwa ajili ya vichakataji vya ARM vinavyotumiwa na simu pekee. Ili kuziendesha kwenye kompyuta hii, Android inahitaji kitafsiri. NickelOS haitengenezi wala haijumuishi kitafsiri: ukiwasha kipengele hiki, TRANSLATOR itapakuliwa kutoka GitHub, nakala ileile ambayo waydroid_script ya jumuiya ya Waydroid husakinisha.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.en: It's proprietary software, under its owner's terms, and you're the one installing it. Some apps may run slowly or not at all. Android restarts to use it.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.t: Ni programu isiyo huria, inayotumika chini ya masharti ya mmiliki wake, na wewe ndiye unayeisakinisha. Huenda baadhi ya programu zikaenda polepole au zisifanye kazi kabisa. Android itazima na kuwashwa ili kuitumia.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_T.t: Ungependa kuwasha uwezo wa kutumia programu za ARM?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_LABEL.t: Uwezo wa kutumia programu za ARM

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ERROR_DOWNLO.en: The download didn't finish. Check your connection, then try again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ERROR_DOWNLO.t: Upakuaji haukukamilika. Kagua muunganisho wako, kisha ujaribu tena.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DESCR.en: Deletes Android, your Android apps and their data
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DESCR.t: Hufuta Android, programu zako za Android na data yake

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DIALO.en: Android, your Android apps and their data are deleted from this device. Other people who use it keep their Android data, but can't open their Android apps until Android is set up again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DIALO.t: Android, programu zako za Android na data yake zitafutwa kwenye kifaa hiki. Watu wengine wanaokitumia watabaki na data yao ya Android, lakini hawataweza kufungua programu zao za Android hadi Android iwekewe mipangilio tena.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_SET_UP_DESCR.en: Android apps open in their own windows, next to your other apps. Setting up downloads Android (LineageOS, from the Waydroid project): about 1 GB, and 2.5 GB on this device.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_SET_UP_DESCR.t: Programu za Android hufunguka katika vidirisha vyake, kando ya programu zako nyingine. Kuweka mipangilio hupakua Android (LineageOS, kutoka mradi wa Waydroid): takribani GB 1, na GB 2.5 kwenye kifaa hiki.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_UNAVAILABLE.en: Android apps aren't available right now.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_UNAVAILABLE.t: Programu za Android hazipatikani kwa sasa.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_USES.en: Android uses SIZE on this device
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_USES.t: Android inatumia SIZE kwenye kifaa hiki

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DESCRIPTION.en: See Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and other cloud storage in Files
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DESCRIPTION.t: Angalia Hifadhi ya Google, OneDrive, Dropbox na hifadhi nyingine za wingu katika Faili

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DRIVE_HELP.en: Google Drive needs your own client ID and secret from the Google Cloud console.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DRIVE_HELP.t: Hifadhi ya Google inahitaji kitambulisho chako mwenyewe cha mteja na siri kutoka kwenye dashibodi ya Google Cloud.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_EMAIL.t: Barua pepe au jina la mtumiaji

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_FAILED.en: Couldn't connect. Check the details and try again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_FAILED.t: Imeshindwa kuunganisha. Kagua maelezo kisha ujaribu tena.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_RCLONE.en: NickelOS uses rclone to show your cloud storage in Files, so your files are easy to reach. Choose a service to sign in to.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_RCLONE.t: NickelOS hutumia rclone kuonyesha hifadhi yako ya wingu katika Faili, ili ufikie faili zako kwa urahisi. Chagua huduma ya kuingia katika akaunti.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_REMOVE_BODY.en: Files stops showing this account. Your files stay in the cloud, and you can add the account again later.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_REMOVE_BODY.t: Programu ya Faili itaacha kuonyesha akaunti hii. Faili zako zitabaki kwenye wingu, na unaweza kuongeza akaunti hii tena baadaye.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_S3.t: Amazon S3 au huduma inayooana nayo

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGNING_IN.en: Finish signing in on the page that opened in your browser.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGNING_IN.t: Maliza kuingia katika akaunti kwenye ukurasa uliofunguka kwenye kivinjari chako.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGN_IN_NOTE.en: When you connect, the service's sign-in page opens in your browser.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGN_IN_NOTE.t: Ukiunganisha, ukurasa wa kuingia katika akaunti wa huduma hiyo utafunguka kwenye kivinjari chako.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_TWO_FACTOR.t: Msimbo wa uthibitishaji wa hatua 2 (ikiwa unautumia)

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_ADMIN_.en: Only an administrator of this computer can change its name.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_ADMIN_.t: Msimamizi wa kompyuta hii pekee ndiye anayeweza kubadilisha jina lake.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_DIALOG.en: Other devices see this name on your network and over Bluetooth, and the Terminal and Linux apps show it.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_DIALOG.t: Vifaa vingine huona jina hili kwenye mtandao wako na kupitia Bluetooth, na Kituo pamoja na programu za Linux hulionyesha.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_FAILED.en: The name couldn't be changed. Try again.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_INVALI.en: Use at least one letter from A to Z or a number.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_INVALI.t: Tumia angalau herufi moja kati ya A hadi Z au tarakimu moja.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DEFAULT_APPS_DESCRIP.en: The apps that open each kind of file, from Files and from Linux apps
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DEFAULT_APPS_DESCRIP.t: Programu zinazofungua kila aina ya faili, kutoka Faili na kutoka programu za Linux

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVES_DESCRIPTION.en: Drives inside this device besides the one with NickelOS. The drive that holds Windows opens read-only, so Windows stays intact.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVES_DESCRIPTION.t: Hifadhi zilizo ndani ya kifaa hiki mbali na ile iliyo na NickelOS. Hifadhi iliyo na Windows hufunguka katika hali ya kusoma tu, ili Windows ibaki salama.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_ALLOW_CHANGES_.en: Windows is on this drive. It's read-only unless you allow changes.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_ALLOW_CHANGES_.t: Windows iko kwenye hifadhi hii. Iko katika hali ya kusoma tu isipokuwa ukiruhusu mabadiliko.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_BODY.en: With Fast Startup, Windows doesn't fully shut down, and changes made here can be lost or damage files when Windows starts again. Turn off Fast Startup in Windows, or hold Shift while you shut Windows down, before you make changes.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_BODY.t: Fast Startup ikiwa imewashwa, Windows haizimi kikamilifu, na mabadiliko unayofanya hapa yanaweza kupotea au kuharibu faili Windows itakapowashwa tena. Kabla ya kufanya mabadiliko, zima Fast Startup katika Windows, au ushikilie Shift unapozima Windows.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_TITLE.en: Allow changes to the Windows drive?
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_TITLE.t: Ungependa kuruhusu mabadiliko kwenye hifadhi ya Windows?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_HIBERNATED.en: Windows didn't shut down fully, so the drive stays read-only. Shut down Windows fully to make changes.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_HIBERNATED.t: Windows haikuzimwa kikamilifu, kwa hivyo hifadhi inabaki katika hali ya kusoma tu. Zima Windows kikamilifu ili ufanye mabadiliko.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_COMMUNITY_DESCR.en: The forum, Discord and GitHub, on nickelos.dev
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_COMMUNITY_DESCR.t: Jukwaa, Discord na GitHub kwenye nickelos.dev

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GENTOO_DESCRIPT.en: Portage and emerge from the start, with pacman and apt commands side by side
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GENTOO_DESCRIPT.t: Portage na emerge tangu mwanzo, pamoja na amri zinazolingana za pacman na apt kando kwa kando

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GUIDE_DESCRIPTI.en: How NickelOS works. This copy came with your version of NickelOS and works offline.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GUIDE_DESCRIPTI.t: Jinsi NickelOS inavyofanya kazi. Nakala hii ilikuja na toleo lako la NickelOS na inafanya kazi hata nje ya mtandao.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_MENU_ITEM_DESCR.t: Mwongozo, kujifunza Gentoo, utatuzi wa matatizo

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_TROUBLESHOOTING.en: Logs, crash reports, and the usual problems and their fixes
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_TROUBLESHOOTING.t: Kumbukumbu, ripoti za programu kuacha kufanya kazi, na matatizo ya kawaida pamoja na jinsi ya kuyarekebisha

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_DESCRIPTION.en: With the KDE Connect app on Android or iPhone, on the same Wi‑Fi network
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_DESCRIPTION.t: Kupitia programu ya KDE Connect kwenye Android au iPhone, katika mtandao mmoja wa Wi‑Fi

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NONE.en: No phones or tablets yet. Install KDE Connect from Google Play, F‑Droid or the App Store, open it on the same Wi‑Fi network, then pair from either device.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NONE.t: Bado hakuna simu wala kompyuta kibao. Sakinisha KDE Connect kutoka Google Play, F‑Droid au App Store, ifungue katika mtandao mmoja wa Wi‑Fi, kisha uoanishe kutoka kwenye kifaa chochote kati ya hivyo.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NOT_RUNNING.en: The phone connection isn't running. Sign out and back in to start it.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NOT_RUNNING.t: Muunganisho wa simu haufanyi kazi. Ondoka kisha uingie tena katika akaunti ili uuanzishe.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_WANTS_TO_PAIR.en: Wants to pair with this device

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_DESCRIPTION.en: Lets apps such as Discord use push-to-talk while you're in other windows. They see keys pressed with Ctrl, Alt or Search and function keys, never what you type.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_DESCRIPTION.t: Huruhusu programu kama vile Discord kutumia kipengele cha bonyeza ili uzungumze ukiwa kwenye vidirisha vingine. Programu hizo huona tu vitufe vilivyobonyezwa pamoja na Ctrl, Alt au Tafuta na vitufe vya kukokotoa, kamwe si unachoandika.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_LABEL.en: Shortcut keys for older Linux apps
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_LABEL.t: Vitufe vya njia za mkato kwa programu za zamani za Linux

IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_HELP_SECTION_.en: Make sure your printer is connected to the same Wi-Fi network as your NickelOS device or use a USB cable. LINK_BEGINLearn more about compatibilityLINK_END
IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_HELP_SECTION_.t: Hakikisha kuwa printa yako imeunganishwa kwenye mtandao mmoja wa Wi-Fi sawa na kifaa chako cha NickelOS au utumie kebo ya USB. LINK_BEGINPata maelezo zaidi kuhusu hali ya uoanifuLINK_END

IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_PRINTER_ADDED.en: Can’t connect to printer. Check that the printer is turned on and is connected to your NickelOS device by Wi-Fi or USB.
IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_PRINTER_ADDED.t: Imeshindwa kuunganisha kwenye printa. Hakikisha kuwa printa imewashwa na imeunganishwa kwenye kifaa chako cha NickelOS kwa kutumia Wi-Fi au USB.

IDS_SETTINGS_SECURE_DNS_OPEN_CHROME_OS_S.en: Manage secure DNS in NickelOS settings
IDS_SETTINGS_SECURE_DNS_OPEN_CHROME_OS_S.t: Dhibiti kipengele cha DNS salama kwenye mipangilio ya NickelOS

IDS_SETTINGS_SWITCH_ACCESS_SETUP_INTRO_B.en: To get started, please make sure your USB or Bluetooth switch is connected to your NickelOS device. You can also use keyboard keys.
IDS_SETTINGS_SWITCH_ACCESS_SETUP_INTRO_B.t: Ili uanze, tafadhali hakikisha kwamba swichi yako ya USB au Bluetooth imeunganishwa kwenye kifaa chako cha NickelOS. Unaweza pia kutumia vitufe vya kibodi.

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_LOOKING_FOR_PHONE.en: To unlock your NickelOS device, make sure your phone's Bluetooth is on
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_LOOKING_FOR_PHONE.t: Ili kufungua kifaa chako cha NickelOS, hakikisha Bluetooth ya simu yako imewashwa

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_BLUETOOTH.en: Your NickelOS device’s Bluetooth is off. To unlock your NickelOS device, enter password.
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_BLUETOOTH.t: Bluetooth imezimwa kwenye kifaa chako cha NickelOS. Ili ukifungue, weka nenosiri.

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_PHONE_LOCK_SCREE.en: Your phone doesn’t have a lock screen. To unlock your NickelOS device, enter password.
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_PHONE_LOCK_SCREE.t: Simu yako haina kipengele cha kufunga skrini. Ili ufungue kifaa chako cha NickelOS, weka nenosiri.

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_PHONE_LOCKED.en: To unlock your NickelOS device, first unlock your phone
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_PHONE_LOCKED.t: Ili ufungue kifaa chako cha NickelOS, fungua simu yako kwanza

IDS_SMART_PRIVACY_PROTECTION_CONTENT.en: Your device uses a built-in sensor to detect people in front of it. All data is processed on your device immediately and then deleted. Sensor data is never sent to Google.
IDS_SMART_PRIVACY_PROTECTION_CONTENT.t: Kifaa chako kinatumia kitambuzi kilicho ndani yake ili kutambua watu walioko mbele yake. Data yote inachakatwa kwenye kifaa chako papo hapo kisha inafutwa. Data ya vitambuzi haitumwi Google.

IDS_SYNC_OTHER_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW.en: NickelOS could not sync your data due to an error signing in.
IDS_SYNC_OTHER_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW.t: NickelOS haikuweza kusawazisha data yako kutokana na hitilafu wakati wa kuingia katika akaunti.

IDS_SYNC_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_MESSA.en: NickelOS could not sync your data because your account sign-in details are out of date.
IDS_SYNC_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_MESSA.t: NickelOS haikusawazisha data yako kwa sababu maelezo ya kuingia katika akaunti yako yamepitwa na wakati.

IDS_SYNC_UNAVAILABLE_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_M.en: NickelOS could not sync your data because Sync is not available for your domain.
IDS_SYNC_UNAVAILABLE_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_M.t: NickelOS haikusawazisha data yako kwa sababu Usawazishaji haupatikani kwa kikoa chako.

IDS_TERMS_OF_SERVICE_SCREEN_SUBHEADING.en: MANAGER requires that you read and accept the following Terms of Service before using this device. These terms do not expand, modify or limit the NickelOS Terms.
IDS_TERMS_OF_SERVICE_SCREEN_SUBHEADING.t: MANAGER inahitaji usome na ukubali Sheria na Masharti yafuatayo kabla ya kutumia kifaa hiki. Masharti haya hayapanui, hayarekebishi wala hayapunguzi Sheria na Masharti ya NickelOS.

IDS_UPDATE_RECOMMENDED.en: NickelOS needs to be restarted to apply the update.
IDS_UPDATE_RECOMMENDED.t: NickelOS inahitaji kuzimwa na kuwashwa ili itekeleze usasishaji.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TEXT.en: You’ll sign in to your device with your own account, and everyone who uses it can have one.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TEXT.t: Utaingia katika kifaa chako ukitumia akaunti yako mwenyewe, na kila mtu anayekitumia anaweza kuwa na yake.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TITLE.en: Your own account on your device
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TITLE.t: Akaunti yako mwenyewe kwenye kifaa chako

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ANTIVIRUS_TEXT.en: NickelOS is designed with security in mind, and it keeps itself up to date automatically.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ANTIVIRUS_TEXT.t: NickelOS imebuniwa kwa kuzingatia usalama, na hujisasisha yenyewe kiotomatiki.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_APPS_TEXT.en: NickelOS runs web apps and Linux apps side by side. Get apps for productivity, entertainment, and more.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_APPS_TEXT.t: NickelOS huendesha programu za wavuti na programu za Linux bega kwa bega. Pata programu za tija, burudani na zaidi.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_UPDATE_TEXT.en: This is the only time you’ll wait for an update. On NickelOS, software updates happen in the background.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_UPDATE_TEXT.t: Huu ndio wakati pekee utakaposubiri sasisho. Kwenye NickelOS, masasisho ya programu hutendeka chinichini.

IDS_USER_INSTALLED_CHROME_APP_DEPRECATIO.en: Chrome apps don’t run on NickelOS. Consider an alternative app.
IDS_USER_INSTALLED_CHROME_APP_DEPRECATIO.t: Programu za Chrome hazifanyi kazi kwenye NickelOS. Zingatia kutumia programu mbadala.

IDS_WRONG_HWID_SCREEN_MESSAGE_FIRST_PART.en: Unfortunately, your computer is configured with a malformed hardware ID. This prevents NickelOS from updating with the latest security fixes and your computer BEGIN_BOLDmay be vulnerable to malicious attacksEND_BOLD.
IDS_WRONG_HWID_SCREEN_MESSAGE_FIRST_PART.t: Kwa bahati mbaya, kompyuta yako imewekewa mipangilio na kitambulisho cha maunzi yenye hitilafu. Hali hii huzuia NickelOS isisasishe marekebisho ya usalama ya hivi karibuni na kompyuta yako BEGIN_BOLDinaweza kuwa hatarini kutokana na mashambulizi hasidiEND_BOLD.
